about_the_game:
✨Mine. Refine. Profit. Conquer the stars.
In Asteroid Miner (working title), you command your own fleet of mining ships as you venture into the endless expanse of space. Carve through asteroid belts, discover rare resources, and transform raw ore into valuable materials. Upgrade your equipment, expand your operations, and become the ultimate space industrialist.

🚀 Core Features

  • Deep Mining Gameplay – Scan asteroid belts, lock onto targets, and extract valuable ores with precision.

  • Refine & Craft – Process raw materials into advanced alloys and components to power your upgrades.

  • Build & Upgrade – Improve your ships, refine faster, unlock new tech, and scale your operation from a single rig to a galactic enterprise.

  • Risk & Reward Exploration – Travel between belts and systems with varying levels of danger, reward, and resource density.

  • Idle-Friendly Progression – Your mining continues even when you’re away. Log back in to collect your haul and reinvest in growth.

  • Strategic Decisions – Balance refining queues, cargo management, and market trading to maximize your profit.

🌌 Why Play Asteroid Miner?

If you’ve ever dreamed of commanding a mining fleet like in EVE Online, managing resources like Factorio, or watching your empire grow like in Cookie Clicker, this game combines the best of those worlds with a streamlined, accessible design. Whether you play for a few minutes or lose yourself for hours, every decision builds toward your rise as a space mining tycoon.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD equivalent, or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: An idle space mining simulator that lets you scan, extract, and refine asteroids while upgrading ships and managing resources.
